name: GEMM 64x64x32 (INT16 x INT16 -> INT32, scalar)
signature: void matmul_scalar_i16_i32(int16_t* a_in, int16_t* b_in, int32_t* c_out);
description: Scalar (non-vectorized) INT16 x INT16 matrix multiply with INT32 accumulating output, fixed to a 64x64x32 (m x k x n) tile via compile_flags. c_out is accumulated into (not overwritten), so callers must zero it first when reducing over multiple K-tiles. Instantiated from mm.cc's combos macro.
